title: Application of the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996 to the Refunded Portion of Certain Federal Refundable Tax Credits; Hearing Cancellation
summary: Treasury Department, Internal Revenue Service — Proposed Rule — This document cancels a public hearing on proposed regulations (REG-119882-25) published in the Federal Register on August 20, 2026. The proposed regulations would provide that the refunded portion of certain refundable Federal income tax credits available to individuals is a "Federal public benefit" under the Personal Responsibility and Work Opportunity Reconciliation Act of 1996 (PRWORA).

title: Passenger Vehicle and Light Truck Tires From Thailand: Preliminary Results and Rescission, in Part, of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
summary: Commerce Department, International Trade Administration — Notice — The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that passenger vehicle and light truck tires (PVLT) from Thailand were sold in the United States at less than normal value during the period of review (POR) July 1, 2024, through June 30, 2025. Interested parties are invited to comment on these preliminary results.

title: Certain Hot-Rolled Steel Flat Products From the Republic of Korea: Final Results of Countervailing Duty Administrative Review; 2023
summary: Commerce Department, International Trade Administration — Notice — The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) determines Hyundai Steel Company (Hyundai Steel) and POSCO, producers/exporters of certain hot-rolled steel flat products (hot-rolled steel) from the Republic of Korea (Korea), received countervailable subsidies during the period of review (POR) January 1, 2023, through December 31, 2023.

title: Certain Paper Shopping Bags From Cambodia: Preliminary Results of Antidumping Duty Administrative Review; 2024-2025
summary: Commerce Department, International Trade Administration — Notice — The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that certain paper shopping bags (paper shopping bags) from Cambodia were sold in the United States at less than normal value (NV) during the period of review (POR), January 3, 2024, through June 30, 2025. Interested parties are invited to comment on these preliminary results of review.
